svg.title: capture-system-or-process-audio — Cross-Platform System, Application & Microphone Audio Capture
svg.desc: Cross-platform system speaker loopback, single application/process, and microphone PCM audio capture and live mixer for Python, Rust, C++17, and C11 across Windows (WASAPI), Linux (PipeWire & PulseAudio), and macOS (Core Audio Process Taps & ScreenCaptureKit).
